summary: Backend: 26/26 pytest passed (games, results, stats, update, generate for all 3 games with all 4 strategies; 404 handling; SuperEnalotto jolly/superstar; 10elotto oro; date-desc ordering; correct main count/max_number; no duplicates in tickets). Frontend: all UI flows verified via Playwright on public URL - header, 3 game selectors, force-update button with success toast, game switching, stats tabs (frequent/late), generator producing tickets, archive list. Scraper confirmed working against estrazionedellotto.it (12 draws for SuperEnalotto).

issues: Recharts logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on mount (during initial load state) — cosmetic, chart renders correctly once container is sized. Consider setting a minHeight on the ResponsiveContainer wrapper to suppress.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: variable name 'results' inside POST /api/update shadows the outer 'results' route function name — works but is stylistically confusing.
APScheduler cron uses hour='21,22,23' without a timezone; server runs in UTC so job fires 3h later than Italian evening draws. Consider setting timezone='Europe/Rome' on the scheduler.
compute_stats is O(N * max_number) per call and re-runs on every /stats and /generate request; fine for current scale but consider caching.
Generator 'balanced' strategy may produce fewer than `count` picks when hot+cold pool <count; the fallback random.randint loop is fine but not weighted.
seed_data_creation: Initial scrape triggered automatically by startup_update(); populated 12 SuperEnalotto draws + VinciCasa + 10elotto from live source.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend runs live scraping against estrazionedellotto.it and stores in Mongo. Tests are idempotent (upsert on game+date). Public URL: https://lotto-lab-fix.preview.emergentagent.com. No auth.
